data.body:
Fixes bug Bebc6fe14a1: ddflow/core/globs.py:114 overlap only treats * and ? as wildcards when taking the literal prefix; '[' is literal. Probe: overlap('src/[ab]x.py','src/ax*') and the reverse both return False although src/ax.py matches both (prefixes 'src/[ab]x.py' and 'src/ax' neither startswith the other; fnmatch of either pattern against the other fails). Two claims can therefore be granted on files they both write. Other class cases (src/[ab]*.py vs src/a*.py) are caught by luck of fnmatch. Fix: cut the prefix at the first of * ? [ and add a regression table with class cases.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bebc6fe14a1 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bebc6fe14a1 --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug Bebc6fe14a1: globs.overlap misses a character-class glob against a literal-prefix glob (src/[ab]x.py vs src/ax*)
